subject: Future Tech
title: Nano Water Purification
description: A quick win: understand Nano Water Purification.

hook.text: Graphene oxide membranes filter salt from seawater at the molecular level.

buildup.text: Traditional desalination forces water through polymer membranes at high pressure.

twist.text: Nano-silver particles kill bacteria in water filters without chemicals.

climax.text: Portable nano-filters could provide clean water to the 2 billion people who currently lack it.

punchline.text: Nano-pores too small for bacteria. Clean water for all.

quiz.question: How do graphene oxide membranes purify water?
options: They heat water to kill bacteria
They filter at molecular level with precise nanoscale pores
They add chemicals to neutralize toxins
